afterburn.downstream_note: Afterburn is an enemy debuff (tags.ts afterburn handler at the pin): while active on following rounds, every instant damage consequence the debuffed target receives (any source, pierce excluded) adds floor(damage x percent) Afterburn damage, with the cumulative Afterburn on one hit capped at 60% of that hit. Potency raises the percent, not the duration. Downstream coverage is therefore every non-pierce hit landed on the target during the debuff, including normal jutsu, weapons and allies; it is not measured by the application-row count and was not simulated.
